| 50 | Detail and Confirm Payment | Payment | Shows payment lines with unit price, insurance amount and patient amount, and allows the cashier to select payment method and confirm the payment |
| 51 | Print Invoice | Payment | Prints the invoice after payment is confirmed |
| 52 | Payment History | Payment | Shows the list of collected payments with search by invoice number, patient and date |
| 53 | Detail Payment | Payment | Shows full details of a collected payment |

### 

### **5.2 External API Inventory** {#5.2-external-api-inventory}

| \# | API Name | Calling Path | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Cloudinary Upload API | Backend \=\>POST https\://api.cloudinary.com/v1\_1/{cloud\_name}/auto/upload | Uploads paraclinical result files (images, PDF) and returns a file URL stored in PARACLINICAL\_RESULT. Used on the Update Result screen. |

### **5.3 Background Job Inventory** {#5.3-background-job-inventory}

| \# | Job Name | Group | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Cancel unattended registrations | Scheduled | Daily at 23:30. Registrations still in Waiting status at the end of the day are set to ABANDONED. |
| 2 | Cancel expired pending payments | Scheduled | Daily at 23:45. Pending payments of cancelled registrations, or pending payments not paid by the end of the day, are set to Cancelled together with their paraclinical orders. |
| 3 | Reset daily queue counters | Scheduled | Daily at 00:00. Resets the queue number counter of every clinical department so that the first registration of the new day starts from 1\. |
| 4 | Aggregate daily statistics | Scheduled | Daily at 01:00. Calculates the previous day’s revenue, insurance amount, visit count, doctor performance and paraclinical service count, and stores them for the Admin statistics screens. |
| 5 | Back up database | Scheduled | Daily at 02:00. Creates a full database backup and keeps the latest 30 backups. |
| 6 | Prepare follow-up appointment list | Scheduled | Daily at 06:00. Builds the list of patients whose follow-up date is today, so receptionists can see them on the Receptionist Dashboard. |
| 7 | Unlock temporarily locked accounts | Scheduled | Every 15 minutes. Unlocks accounts that were locked after too many failed login attempts once the lock period has expired. |
| 8 | Notify doctor of completed results | Event-driven | Triggered when all items of a paraclinical order are completed. Sets the order to Completed, moves the registration to Pending Conclusion, and sends a real-time notification to the examining doctor. |
| 10 | Update waiting lists after payment | Event-driven | Triggered when a payment is confirmed. Sets the related paraclinical order to Paid and pushes its services to the waiting lists of the performing departments. |

# **II. Use Case Specifications** {#ii.-use-case-specifications}

## **1\. Authentication & Profile** {#1.-authentication-&-profile}

### **1.1 UC-01: Login** {#1.1-uc-01:-login}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Description | As a staff member, I want to sign in with my username and password so that I can use only the functions of my role (BR-02) and, for Doctors and Technicians, the patients and services of the room I am assigned to (BR-05, BR-19).  |  |  |
| Preconditions | The user has an account created by the Admin (UC-07). The user is not signed in on this browser. |  |  |
| Normal Flow | The user opens the system URL or a protected page. The system displays the “Đăng nhập” screen with “Tên đăng nhập”, “Mật khẩu” (hidden, with the “Hiện mật khẩu” / “Ẩn mật khẩu” icon), the “Ghi nhớ phiên đăng nhập” checkbox, the “Quên mật khẩu?” link and the “Đăng nhập” button. The user enters the username and password and clicks “Đăng nhập” (or presses Enter). The system checks that both fields are filled in. The system finds the account by username. The username is not case-sensitive, and leading and trailing spaces are ignored.  The system checks that password sign-in for the account is not temporarily blocked after repeated failed attempts (Security: Account lockout, IV.2.3). The system checks the password (BR-01). The error message never says whether the username or the password is wrong. The system checks that the account is not Locked (BR-01).  The system resets the failed sign-in count of the account to 0, saves the last sign-in time, creates a new session and records the sign-in in the security audit log (account, time, result, request ID). The system checks whether the account must change its password (new account or password reset by the Admin).  The system opens the home screen of the user’s role (UI-02) and shows only the menu items allowed for the role (BR-02, Permission Matrix 4.4): 11.1. Admin: Admin Dashboard. 11.2. Receptionist: Receptionist Dashboard. 11.3. Doctor: Doctor Dashboard (waiting list of the doctor’s assigned room). 11.4. Technician: Technician Dashboard (paraclinical waiting list of the technician’s assigned room). 11.5. Cashier: Cashier Dashboard (waiting payment list).  |  |  |
| Alternative Flows | AF-01 (at step 1): The user already has a valid session 1.1. The system restores the session stored in the browser and skips the “Đăng nhập” screen.1.2. The use case continues at step 11\. AF-02 (at step 10): The password must be changed 2.1. The sign-in succeeds, but the resulting session is restricted. 2.2. Until the password is changed, the user may only view their own profile, change the password through UC-03, and log out through UC-02. Updating the profile and accessing other business functions are prohibited. 2.3. The backend rejects every other protected request, independently of the user’s normal role permissions. 2.4. The system shows MSG44 and opens the “Đổi mật khẩu” screen. 2.5. After the password is successfully changed, the system renews the session without the restriction and continues at step 11\.  AF-03 (at step 11): The user was redirected to Login from a protected page  3.1. Before displaying Login, the web client stores the requested internal route as the post-login destination. 3.2. Sensitive patient, medical or authentication data is not stored in the destination URL. 3.3. After successful sign-in, the system checks whether the user’s role is authorized to access the stored route. 3.4. If authorized, the system opens the originally requested route. 3.5. If unauthorized, the system shows MSG13 and opens the home screen of the user’s role. 3.6. The stored destination is cleared after it is used. 3.7. The use case ends.  AF-04 (at step 11): A Doctor or Technician has no active room assignment  4.1. The system determines whether the Doctor or Technician has an active room assignment. 4.2. If no active room assignment exists, the system opens the role’s home screen and shows MSG48. 4.3. Room-dependent waiting lists and work functions are unavailable or empty. 4.4. Other authorized functions that do not depend on a room remain available. 4.5. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| Exception Flows | EF-01 (at step 4): A field is empty 1.1. The “Đăng nhập” button remains disabled until both fields contain non-blank values. 1.2. If a request with an empty field still reaches the backend, the web client maps the validation response to MSG02. 1.3. Raw backend error messages are not displayed. 1.4. The use case returns to step 3\.  EF-02 (at steps 5 or 7): The username does not exist or the password is wrong 2.1. The system shows MSG09 without saying which field is wrong.2.2. If the username exists, the system adds 1 to its failed sign-in count and records the failed attempt in the audit log.2.3. The system clears the “Mật khẩu” field.2.4. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 7): Fifth consecutive wrong password 3.1. The system records the fifth consecutive failed sign-in attempt in the security audit log. 3.2. The system blocks password sign-in for the account for 15 minutes and resets the failed sign-in count to 0\. 3.3. The system records the temporary block in the security audit log. 3.4. The system shows MSG11: “Bạn đã nhập sai quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau 15 phút.” 3.5. No authenticated session is created. 3.6. The block ends automatically after 15 minutes and does not change the account status to Locked. 3.7. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 6): Password sign-in is temporarily blocked 4.1. The system refuses the sign-in even if the entered password is correct. 4.2. The system shows MSG11: “Bạn đã nhập sai quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau 15 phút.” 4.3. The system records the failed sign-in attempt in the security audit log. 4.4. The failed sign-in count does not increase and the current block expiry time does not change. 4.5. No authenticated session is created. 4.6. The use case ends.  EF-05 (at step 8): The account is Locked 5.1. The system refuses the sign-in even if the entered password is correct. 5.2. The system shows MSG10: “Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.” 5.3. The system records the failed sign-in attempt in the security audit log. 5.4. No authenticated session is created and the account remains Locked. 5.5. Only the Admin can unlock the account through UC-10. 5.6. The use case ends. EF-06 (at steps 5–9): Server, system or network error  6.1. The web client maps the error to MSG80. 6.2. Raw backend messages, exception text and English infrastructure errors are not displayed. 6.3. No session is created. 6.4. The user remains on the “Đăng nhập” screen and may retry. 6.5. The use case returns to step 3\.  |  |  |
| Postconditions | Success: the user has a session, sees the home screen and menu of their role, and the sign-in is recorded in the audit log. The access token is valid for 15 minutes and is renewed automatically while the session is active. The session ends after 2 hours without activity, 12 hours after sign-in at the latest (Security: Session timeout, IV.2.3), or by Logout (UC-02). Failure: no session is created; failed attempts on existing accounts are counted and logged; password sign-in may be blocked for 15 minutes (EF-03).  |  |  |
| Business Rules | BR-01, BR-02, BR-05, BR-19; Security: Password protection, Account lockout, Session timeout (IV.2.3); Permission Matrix 4.4  |  |  |
| Messages | MSG02, MSG09, MSG10,MSG11,MSG13,MSG44, MSG48, MSG80 |  |  |

### **1.2 UC-02: Logout** {#1.2-uc-02:-logout}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----- | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a staff member, I want to sign out so that my session ends and nobody else can use my account on a shared workstation (for example at shift change).  |  |  |
| Preconditions | The user is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| Normal Flow | The user opens the account menu in the header and clicks “Đăng xuất”. The web client sends a logout request containing the current refresh-token cookie. The system verifies that the request originates from the permitted clinic web application. If the refresh token identifies an active session, the system revokes that session. Other sessions belonging to the same account remain active. The system records the logout in the security audit log when an active session is successfully revoked. The system clears the refresh-token cookie. Whether the server request succeeds or fails, the web client clears its locally stored access token and authentication state. The system displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows | AF-01 (at step 4): The session has already ended or expired 1.1. The system does not find an active session to revoke. 1.2. No new logout audit entry is created. 1.3. The system still clears the refresh-token cookie and returns a successful logout response. 1.4. The web client clears its authentication state and displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. AF-02 (after step 4): The system is open in another browser tab 2.1. Revoking the server session prevents the refresh token from being used again. 2.2. An access token already issued to another tab may remain usable until it expires. 2.3. When that tab attempts to refresh the session, the request is rejected and the user must sign in again. AF-03 (before step 1): Automatic session expiration 3.1. The session expires after its configured inactivity or absolute lifetime. 3.2. When the web client can no longer refresh the session, it clears its authentication state and displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. 3.3. The user signs in again through UC-01. |  |  |
| Exception Flows | EF-01 (at step 3): The logout request does not originate from the permitted web application 1.1. The server rejects the request with Forbidden. 1.2. No server session is revoked. 1.3. The current web client still clears its local authentication state and displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. EF-02 (at step 2): The server cannot be reached 2.1. The web client still clears its local access token and authentication state. 2.2. The system displays the “Đăng nhập” screen. 2.3. The server session remains valid until it expires or is revoked later. |  |  |
| Postconditions | Success: the current server session is revoked when it exists, the refresh-token cookie is cleared, and the current web client holds no authentication state. An audit entry is created only when an active server session is actually revoked. Server or network failure: the current web client clears its local authentication state and displays the Login screen, but the server session may remain valid until it expires or is revoked later. The current implementation does not check for unsaved form data and does not display an unsaved-data confirmation before logout.  |  |  |
| Business Rules | BR-19; Security: Authentication required, Session timeout, Audit trail (IV.2.3)  |  |  |
| Messages | MSG12 |  |  |

### **1.3 UC-03: Change Password** {#1.3-uc-03:-change-password}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Description | As a staff member, I want to change my own password after entering my current password, so that my account stays secure. A forgotten password can only be reset by the Admin through UC-11.  |  |  |
| Preconditions | The user is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| Normal Flow | The user opens the account menu and selects “Đổi mật khẩu”. The system displays: “Mật khẩu hiện tại”\* “Mật khẩu mới”\* “Nhập lại mật khẩu mới”\* “Hiện”/“Ẩn” controls for each password field The “Yêu cầu mật khẩu” panel The user fills in all three fields and clicks “Đổi mật khẩu”. After the user clicks “Đổi mật khẩu”, the web client checks that all three required fields contain non-blank values. If any field is empty, the use case continues at EF-01. The web client checks that “Mật khẩu mới”: Has between 8 and 64 Unicode characters. Does not exceed 72 UTF-8 bytes. Is different from “Mật khẩu hiện tại”. The web client checks that “Nhập lại mật khẩu mới” matches “Mật khẩu mới”. The confirmation value is not sent to the backend. The backend verifies that the account still exists and is Active. If the account was locked during the session, the request is refused. The backend checks whether password sign-in is temporarily blocked, then verifies “Mật khẩu hiện tại”. The backend repeats the password policy check and verifies that the new password is different from the current password. The system: Saves the new password in protected form. Clears the “must change password” flag. Resets the failed-attempt count and temporary password-sign-in block. Revokes all other refresh sessions of the account. Keeps the current session active. Existing access tokens belonging to other sessions may remain usable until they expire, for at most 15 minutes. Revoked sessions cannot obtain new access tokens. The system records PASSWORD\_CHANGED in the security audit log. Password values and password hashes are not recorded. The web client shows MSG15: 'Đổi mật khẩu thành công.' , refreshes the current session and opens the home screen of the user’s role.  |  |  |
| Alternative Flows | AF-01 (before step 1): Required change after account creation or password reset1.1. After sign-in, the system detects that passwordChangeRequired is true.1.2. The system immediately displays the password-change screen and informs the user that the temporary password must be changed.1.3. Navigation to other application functions is prevented.1.4. Only “Đổi mật khẩu” and “Đăng xuất” remain usable.1.5. The “Hủy” action is not displayed.1.6. The use case continues at Normal Flow step 2\.1.7. After step 13, the web client refreshes the current session to obtain an unrestricted access token.1.8. The system opens the home screen for the user’s role. AF-02 (at step 3): The user cancels the password change2.1. The user clicks “Hủy” or uses the form’s Back action.2.2. This option is unavailable when the password change is mandatory.2.3. The system closes the password-change form and returns to the previous authorized screen.2.4. All entered password values are discarded.2.5. The password and account data remain unchanged.2.6. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 3): The user has forgotten the current password3.1. The user cannot complete the password change without entering the current password.3.2. The user asks an Admin to reset the password through UC-11.3.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| Exception Flows | EF-01 (at step 4): A required field is empty1.1. The user clicks “Đổi mật khẩu” while one or more required fields are empty. 1.2. The web client displays MSG02 in red under each empty field:      \- “Mật khẩu hiện tại là bắt buộc.”      \- “Mật khẩu mới là bắt buộc.”      \- “Mật khẩu xác nhận là bắt buộc.” 1.3. The web client marks each empty field as invalid. 1.4. No request is sent to the backend. 1.5. No password, session or account data is changed. 1.6. The user remains on the “Đổi mật khẩu” screen and continues entering the required fields. 1.7. The use case returns to Normal Flow step 3\. EF-02 (at step 8): “Mật khẩu hiện tại” is wrong2.1. The system increases the account’s failed-login count by one. This is the same counter used by UC-01.2.2. The backend returns CURRENT\_PASSWORD\_INCORRECT.2.3. The web client shows MSG14: “Mật khẩu hiện tại không chính xác.” in the form’s error panel.2.4. The web client marks “Mật khẩu hiện tại” as invalid.2.5. No password or session data is changed.2.6. The use case returns to Normal Flow step 3\. EF-03 (at step 8): Fifth consecutive wrong password3.1. The system temporarily blocks password sign-in for the account for 15 minutes.3.2. The system resets the failed-attempt count to zero.3.3. The system records LOGIN\_THROTTLED in the security audit log.3.4. The current authenticated session remains active.3.5. The backend returns CURRENT\_PASSWORD\_INCORRECT.3.6. The web client shows “Mật khẩu hiện tại không đúng.”3.7. While the block remains active, every password-change attempt is refused, including attempts using the correct current password.3.8. Password sign-in through UC-01 is also refused during the block.3.9. The use case returns to Normal Flow step 3\. EF-04 (at step 5 or step 9): “Mật khẩu mới” breaks the password policy4.1. The web client or backend detects that “Mật khẩu mới” has fewer than 8 characters, more than 64 Unicode characters, or more than 72 UTF-8 bytes.4.2. The web client displays MSG41 in the form’s error panel: “Mật khẩu phải có độ dài từ 8–64 ký tự.”4.3. The web client marks “Mật khẩu mới” as invalid.4.4. If the violation is detected by the web client, no request is sent to the backend.4.5. No password or account data is changed.4.6. The use case returns to Normal Flow step 3\. EF-05 (at step 5 or step 9): “Mật khẩu mới” equals “Mật khẩu hiện tại”5.1. The web client or backend detects that the new password equals the current password.5.2. The web client shows MSG37: “Mật khẩu mới phải khác mật khẩu hiện tại.” in the form’s error panel.5.3. The web client marks “Mật khẩu mới” as invalid.5.4. No password or account data is changed.5.5. The use case returns to Normal Flow step 3\. EF-06 (at step 6): The password confirmation does not match6.1. The web client detects that “Nhập lại mật khẩu mới” does not match “Mật khẩu mới”.6.2. The web client shows MSG42: “Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp.” in the form’s error panel.6.3. The web client marks “Nhập lại mật khẩu mới” as invalid.6.4. No request is sent to the backend.6.5. No password or account data is changed.6.6. The use case returns to Normal Flow step 3\. EF-07 (at step 7): The account was locked during the session7.1. The backend determines that the account no longer exists or is no longer Active.7.2. The backend refuses the password change and returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.7.3. The web client clears the local session and asks the user to sign in again.7.4. No password or account data is changed.7.5. The use case ends. EF-08 (at steps 10–12): System error8.1. The password change, session revocation and audit operations are rolled back if the transaction has not been committed.8.2. The old password remains valid.8.3. The web client shows MSG80: 'Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.'8.4. The use case returns to Normal Flow step 3\.  |  |  |
| Postconditions | Success: only the new password works; other sessions of the account are ended; the current session stays active; the change is logged. Failure / Cancelled: the password is not changed. Wrong Current Passwords are counted and may block password sign-in for 15 minutes (EF-03).  |  |  |
| Business Rules | BR-03; Security: Password protection, Account lockout, Audit trail (IV.2.3)  |  |  |
| Messages | MSG02, MSG12, MSG14, MSG15, MSG37, MSG41, MSG42, MSG44, MSG80  |  |  |

### 

### **1.4 UC-04: Update Profile** {#1.4-uc-04:-update-profile}

| Primary Actors | Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Technician, Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a staff member, I want to view and update my own phone number and email in “Hồ sơ cá nhân” so that my contact information stays accurate. The phone number is required; email is optional. Only these two fields can be changed by the account owner (BR-04). Changes are recorded for Admin-only review; viewing change history is outside this use case. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The user is signed in (UC-01) with a valid session. The account is Active and the user is allowed to access their own profile.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The user opens “Hồ sơ cá nhân”. The system retrieves the signed-in account and displays the current profile. “Số điện thoại” and “Email” are editable. All other account, personal, work-assignment and security information is read-only. The user changes “Số điện thoại” and/or “Email”. The “Lưu thay đổi” button becomes enabled only when at least one editable value differs from the originally loaded value. The user clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The web client validates the submitted phone number and optional email. The system verifies the session, the Active account status and that the request modifies only the signed-in account’s editable contact fields. The system checks that the phone number and any non-empty email are not used by another account, including Locked accounts. Email comparison is case-insensitive. The system saves the changed contact values atomically. The system creates one account change-history record containing all fields that actually changed, their previous and new values, the signed-in account as the actor, and the change time.  The system returns the updated profile. The web client displays MSG03 with item \= “Hồ sơ”:  “Hồ sơ cập nhật thành công.” |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): Clear the optional Email 1.1. The user clears “Email”. 1.2. The system accepts the empty value. 1.3. The use case continues with validation and saving. AF-02 (at steps 4–6): Cancel editing 2.1. The user clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 2.2. The system leaves the profile screen and returns to the previous screen. 2.3. Unsaved values are discarded without a confirmation dialog. AF-03 (at step 5): No values have changed 3.1. The “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled. 3.2. No update request is sent. 3.3. No account change-history entry is created. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 7): “Số điện thoại” is missing 1.1. The system shows MSG02 under “Số điện thoại” and saves nothing.1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 7): Invalid “Số điện thoại” or “Email” format, or “Email” is too long 2.1. If Phone or Email has an invalid format, the system displays MSG05 under the corresponding field:      \- “Số điện thoại không đúng định dạng.”      \- “Email không đúng định dạng.” 2.2. If Email exceeds 100 characters, the system displays MSG08:      “Vượt quá độ dài tối đa 100 ký tự.” 2.3. The invalid field is marked as invalid. 2.4. No profile or change-history data is saved. 2.5. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 9): “Số điện thoại” or “Email” is already used by another account 3.1. If Phone is already used, the system displays MSG07:      “Số điện thoại đã tồn tại trong hệ thống.” 3.2. If Email is already used, the system displays MSG07:      “Email đã tồn tại trong hệ thống.” 3.3. The conflicting field is marked as invalid. 3.4. No profile or change-history data is saved. 3.5. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 8): Session expired or invalid 4.1. The system shows MSG12, rejects the update and opens Login; nothing is saved.4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at step 8): The account was locked/deactivated during the session 5.1. The system rejects the update and shows MSG12.5.2. No profile or history changes are committed.5.3. The use case ends. EF-06 (at steps 9–10): Concurrent duplicate or system/database error 6.1. The system detects a uniqueness conflict or a system/database error. 6.2. If a uniqueness conflict occurs, the system displays MSG07 under the conflicting field. The profile and change history remain unchanged, and the use case returns to step 3\. 6.3. If a system/database error occurs, the system displays MSG80:      “Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.” 6.4. The profile and change history remain unchanged. 6.5. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the signed-in account contains the new phone number and optional email. One account change-history record is created for the update and contains every field that actually changed, together with its previous and new values. Cancelled: the user leaves the profile screen and no data is saved. Unchanged: the “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled; no update request or history entry is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-04; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Own profile – Update phone and email); Security: Authentication required, Role-based access, Audit trail (IV.2.3). Validation: required, unique Vietnamese Phone; optional, case-insensitively unique Email. Histories remain available for Locked accounts. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12,MSG80 |  |  |

## **2\. Account Management** {#2.-account-management}

### **2.1 UC-05: View Account List** {#2.1-uc-05:-view-account-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view all staff accounts, including Admin and Locked accounts, and search, filter and sort them so that I can quickly find an account to view or manage. Only Admin can access this list. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Quản lý tài khoản” in the menu. The system displays the “Quản lý tài khoản” screen with: 2.1. Search box “Tìm theo tên đăng nhập, họ tên, số điện thoại hoặc email...”. 2.2. Filters “Tất cả vai trò”, “Tất cả khoa”, “Tất cả trạng thái”, and the “Đặt lại” button. 2.3. Filter values use the Vietnamese labels Quản trị viên, Lễ tân, Bác sĩ, Kỹ thuật viên, Thu ngân; Hoạt động and Đã khóa. 2.4. The “Tạo tài khoản” button. 2.5. Table columns “Tên đăng nhập”, “Họ và tên”, “Khoa / Phòng”, “Vai trò”, “Liên hệ”, “Trạng thái” and “Đăng nhập cuối”. There is no separate “Thao tác” column. Each account row is clickable and opens its detail screen. Missing room assignments show “Chưa phân phòng”. 2.6. Paging with 10 rows per page by default, selectable page sizes 10, 20 and 50, and the total number of accounts. The default sort is creation time, newest first. The Admin enters a search keyword and/or selects filters.  After a short debounce, the system updates the list without reloading the page and returns to page 1\. Search matches username, full name, phone number or email, ignores letter case and Vietnamese accents, and combines search and filters using AND.  The Admin clicks or activates an account row. The system opens “Chi tiết tài khoản” (UC-06). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Sort the list 1.1. The Admin clicks the header “Tên đăng nhập”, “Họ và tên”, “Vai trò”, “Trạng thái” or “Đăng nhập cuối”.1.2. The system sorts the list in ascending order; a second click sorts it in descending order.1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 3): Change page or page size 2.1. The Admin selects another page or changes the number of rows per page (10, 20, 50).2.2. The system shows the selected page and keeps the current search, filters and sort.2.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-03 (at step 3): Clear search and filters 3.1. The Admin clicks “Đặt lại”. 3.2. The system clears the search keyword and resets Role, Department and Status to “Tất cả”. 3.3. The system restores the default sort: creation time, newest first. 3.4. The system returns to page 1 and reloads the account list. 3.5. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-04 (at step 2): Create a new account 4.1. The Admin clicks “Tạo tài khoản” (UC-07).4.2. The system opens the account creation form. The form excludes Admin from the selectable roles; existing Admin accounts remain visible in the account list.4.3. The use case continues in UC-07. AF-05 (at step 2): Return from another account screen 5.1. The Admin returns from UC-06 or UC-07. 5.2. When returning from UC-06, the system keeps the current search, filters, sort, page and page size. 5.3. After an account is successfully created in UC-07, the system reloads the account data and resets the list to page 1 while keeping the current search, filters and sort. 5.4. The use case continues at step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): No account matches 1.1. The system displays MSG01 in the account table:      “Không tìm thấy kết quả.” 1.2. The search box and selected filters remain unchanged. 1.3. The Admin remains on the account list and may change or reset the criteria. 1.4. No account data is changed. 1.5. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system refuses access and displays MSG13:      “Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.” 2.2. A direct request to the account-list or account-department API returns HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN. 2.3. No account information is disclosed. 2.4. The use case ends.  EF-03 (at steps 2–4): Session expired or system error 3.1. If the session is invalid or expired, the web client clears its authentication state, displays MSG12: “Phiên đăng nhập của bạn đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.” and opens the Login screen. 3.2. If the account list or department filters cannot be retrieved because of a system error, the system displays MSG80:      “Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.” 3.3. No account data is changed. 3.4. The Admin may retry the operation. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The accounts matching the criteria are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05; Permission Matrix 4.4 (User account – View list: Admin only). Show Admin and Locked accounts; combined search and filters use AND; room display follows role and assignment status. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

### **2.2 UC-06: View Account Detail** {#2.2-uc-06:-view-account-detail}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view detailed information, authentication activity and account change history for any staff account or my own seeded Admin account, so that I can review its status and manage it through authorized actions. The system has only one seeded Admin account; no additional Admin account can be created or assigned. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin clicks or activates an account row in the account list. The system retrieves the selected account and opens the “Chi tiết tài khoản” screen in read-only mode.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks or activates an account row in the account list.  The system retrieves the selected account and displays its details in read-only mode, including: Account Information: “Tên đăng nhập”, “Vai trò”, “Trạng thái”, “Ngày tạo”, “Người tạo”. Personal Information: “Họ và tên”, “Học hàm / học vị”, “Ngày sinh”, “Giới tính”, “Số điện thoại”, “Email”, “Địa chỉ”. Assignment Information: For Doctor and Technician accounts, the system displays “Khoa”, “Phòng” and assignment details. If no room is assigned, the system displays “Chưa được phân công”. For other roles, the system displays “Không áp dụng cho vai trò này”. Security Information: Last sign-in time, consecutive failed sign-in attempts, account lock status, temporary sign-in blocking information (if applicable), last password change time and whether a password change is required. Recent Activities: The system retrieves up to the 100 most recent recorded sign-in, sign-out and failed sign-in events. The events are displayed in pages of five records, including timestamp, action and IP address where available.  Account Change History: Account changes are displayed in pages of five records, including field label, old value, new value, changed by and changed at. Changes made through UC-04 and UC-08 are included when recorded. The Admin can navigate to older change records.  Passwords, password hashes, and initial or temporary passwords are never displayed. The details of Locked accounts remain accessible to authorized Admin users. The system displays the management actions permitted for the selected account, based on the current Admin's permissions, the selected account's role, status and applicable business rules: “Chỉnh sửa tài khoản”; “Đổi vai trò”; “Khóa tài khoản” or “Mở khóa tài khoản”; “Đặt lại mật khẩu”; “Phân công phòng” for Doctor and Technician accounts; “Quay lại”. Protected system Admin accounts and the currently signed-in Admin's own account are subject to the applicable management restrictions. Unavailable actions are hidden or disabled according to the UI specification. The Admin selects an available management action or clicks “Quay lại”. If a management action is selected, the system opens the corresponding use case. If “Quay lại” is selected, the system returns to the account list. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6): Click “Quay lại” 1.1. The system returns to the account list preserving the previous search, filters, sort order, page and page size (UC-05, AF-05). 1.2. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 6): Perform an account action 2.1. The Admin selects an available account-management action, including “Phân công phòng” for a Doctor or Technician account. 2.2. The system opens UC-08, UC-09, UC-10, UC-11 or UC-15 as appropriate. Selecting “Phân công phòng” opens UC-15. 2.3. After a successful action, the web client updates the cached account detail and refreshes the account list. 2.4. The system returns to or remains on “Chi tiết tài khoản”, depending on the completed action. AF-03 (at steps 4–5): View the requester’s own Admin account 3.1. The Admin may view their own account detail, recent authentication activity and change history. 3.2. “Đổi vai trò”, “Khóa tài khoản” / “Mở khóa tài khoản”, “Đặt lại mật khẩu” and room-assignment actions are unavailable. 3.3. The Admin changes their own password through UC-03 and updates their own phone/email through UC-04. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The account does not exist 1.1. The system shows MSG41 and a button to return to the list. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system refuses access and shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 (and opens the “Đăng nhập” screen) or MSG99. 3.2. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the selected account’s details, authentication activities and paginated change history are available to the Admin. Viewing a Locked account is allowed. Viewing the signed-in Admin’s own account is allowed. No account data is changed. Failure: account details are not displayed when access is denied, the account does not exist or the session is invalid. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-04, BR-05; UC-04 and UC-08 change-history requirements; UC-05 list-state preservation; one seeded Admin with no additional Admin creation/assignment; Security: Password protection, Role-based access and Audit trail (IV.2.3); Permission Matrix 4.4 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG41, MSG99 |  |  |

### **2.3 UC-07: Create Account** {#2.3-uc-07:-create-account}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to create a staff account with login information, exactly one non-Admin role and personal details, so that a new staff member can sign in. Admin cannot create another Admin account through this use case. Staff cannot register themselves. Clinic nurses have no separate account and work under the Doctor account (Actors 4.1). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Tạo tài khoản” on the account list. The system opens “Tạo tài khoản”. The form contains: “Tên đăng nhập”\*; “Vai trò”\*: Lễ tân, Bác sĩ, Kỹ thuật viên or Thu ngân; “Họ và tên”\*; “Học hàm / học vị”; “Số giấy phép hành nghề”; “Ngày sinh”; “Giới tính”; “Số điện thoại”\*; “Email”; “Địa chỉ”. The Admin role is not selectable. Account creation supports GENERATE and MANUAL password modes. The current web form uses GENERATE; MANUAL is available through the backend API with initialPassword. In both modes, the staff member must change the initial password after the first successful sign-in. The Admin completes the form and clicks “Tạo tài khoản”. The web client validates the required fields and field formats. “Học hàm / học vị” and “Số giấy phép hành nghề” are required for Bác sĩ and Kỹ thuật viên.  The current web client sends the account information, password mode GENERATE and a newly generated submission ID. An API client may instead submit passwordMode MANUAL with initialPassword and a new submission ID.  The system validates the request and checks the uniqueness of username, phone number, any non-empty email and any non-empty practice-license number across all accounts, including Locked accounts. In GENERATE mode, the backend generates a 12-character temporary password. In MANUAL mode, it validates the supplied initialPassword against the policy of 8–64 Unicode characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. In either mode, only the secure password hash is stored; an invalid manual password is rejected without creating the account. The system creates an Active account with the selected non-Admin role, no room assignment and passwordChangeRequired \= Yes. The system records the account creation in the audit log without recording the plaintext password or its hash. The system returns the new account ID and the generated or manually supplied initial password once. Both modes set passwordChangeRequired \= Yes; unlike manual password reset in UC-11, manual account creation still requires a password change at first sign-in. The web client retrieves the created account detail. The system displays “Đã tạo tài khoản”, “Mật khẩu tạm thời” and the “Sao chép” button. The Admin selects “Xem chi tiết”, “Tạo tài khoản khác” or “Về danh sách”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 14): Create another account 1.1. The Admin clicks “Tạo tài khoản khác”. 1.2. The system clears the result and opens a new empty creation form. AF-02 (at step 14): View the created account 1\. The Admin clicks “Xem chi tiết”. 2\. The system opens UC-06 for the created account. AF-03 (at step 14): Return to the account list 3.1. The Admin clicks “Về danh sách”. 3.2. The system returns to UC-05. AF-04 (at step 4): Cancel account creation 4.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 4.2. The system immediately returns to the previous screen. 4.3. No account is created. 4.4. The current implementation does not show an unsaved-data confirmation. AF-05 (after step 9): Doctor or Technician account 5.1. The account is created without a room assignment. 5.2. The success result displays:    “Tài khoản chưa được phân công phòng. Phân công phòng làm việc ở chức năng Khoa / Phòng.” 5.3. Room assignment is completed separately. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Required field empty, invalid format or value too long 1.1. The web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese validation message under each invalid field. 1.2. It also displays “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.” 1.3. The request is not sent until client-side errors are corrected. EF-02 (at step 7): Username, phone number, non-empty email or non-empty practice-license number already exists 2.1. The system rejects the request with Conflict. 2.2. The web client displays the corresponding duplicate-field error. 2.3. No account is created. EF-03 (at step 9): Concurrent uniqueness conflict 3.1. A database uniqueness constraint detects a conflict during account creation. 3.2. The transaction is rolled back. 3.3. The web client displays the corresponding duplicate-data error. 3.4. No account is created. EF-04 (at steps 6–9): Unauthorized requester, expired session or system error 4.1. The system rejects a non-Admin requester or an expired session. 4.2. For a network or system error, the web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese error. 4.3. No account is created. EF-05 (at step 5): The practice-license number is missing5.1. The selected role is Doctor or Technician.5.2. “Số giấy phép hành nghề” is empty.5.3. The system shows MSG02 under “Số giấy phép hành nghề”.5.4. No account is created.5.5. The use case returns to the account-creation form. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: a new Active account exists with exactly one non-Admin role. Doctor/Technician accounts may be unassigned to a room and cannot perform room-dependent work until assigned (UC-15). The user can sign in and must change the initial password at first sign-in (UC-01, AF-02). The creation is audited without recording the password. Failure / Cancelled: no account is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-05; UC-04 contact-data rules (required, unique “Số điện thoại”; optional, case-insensitively unique “Email”); role-based “Học hàm / học vị” requirement; Data rule: Unique username (I.3.3); Security: Password protection, Role-based access, Audit trail (IV.2.3) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG99 |  |  |

### **2.4 UC-08: Update Account Information** {#2.4-uc-08:-update-account-information}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the personal and contact information of another non-Admin staff account so that the account displays the latest staff information. The seeded Admin account and the requester’s own account cannot be updated through UC-08. Locked non-Admin accounts may be updated without being unlocked. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in and viewing another staff account in UC-06. The target must not be the Admin's own account; Locked staff accounts may be updated without being unlocked. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Chỉnh sửa tài khoản” on another non-Admin staff account. The system opens “Cập nhật thông tin tài khoản”. The screen displays the account’s current information.                   The editable fields are: “Họ và tên”; “Học hàm / học vị”; “Số giấy phép hành nghề”; “Ngày sinh”; “Giới tính”; “Số điện thoại”; “Email”; “Địa chỉ”.                “Tên đăng nhập” and “Trạng thái” are displayed as disabled fields.The current role is displayed but cannot be changed on this screen. The Admin changes one or more editable values. The “Lưu thay đổi” button becomes enabled only after an editable value differs from the originally loaded value. The Admin clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The web client validates the form. The system verifies Admin authorization, rejects the seeded Admin account and self-administration, and checks the submitted account version. The system validates all editable fields, including “Số giấy phép hành nghề”. The system checks the uniqueness of the phone number, any non-empty email and any non-empty practice-license number across all accounts, including Locked accounts. The system atomically saves all changed editable fields while preserving the username, role and account status. For every stored field whose value actually changes, the system records a separate account change-history entry containing the field, old value, new value, Admin and change time. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client updates its cached account detail, refreshes the account list and returns to the previous screen. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 6–8): Restore the form 1.1. The Admin clicks “Khôi phục”. 1.2. The system restores all editable fields to the values originally loaded. 1.3. The “Lưu thay đổi” and “Khôi phục” buttons become disabled. AF-02 (at steps 6–8): Cancel editing 2.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 2.2. The system returns to the previous screen immediately. 2.3. Unsaved changes are discarded without an unsaved-data confirmation. AF-03 (at step 7): No values have changed 3.1. The “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled. 3.2. No update request is sent. 3.3. No change-history entry is created.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 9): Invalid field value 1.1. The web client displays the Vietnamese validation message under the invalid field. 1.2. It also displays “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.” 1.3. No update request is sent until the client-side errors are corrected. EF-02 (at step 12): A unique account field already exists  2.1. The system detects that the submitted phone number, non-empty email or non-empty practice-license number belongs to another account. 2.2. The system shows MSG07 under each conflicting field. 2.3. No account or change-history data is changed. 2.4. The use case returns to step 6\.  EF-03 (at step 10): Protected account or self-update 3.1. The system rejects updating an account having the ADMIN role. 3.2. The web client displays “Không thể thực hiện thao tác này trên tài khoản Quản trị viên.” 3.3. A direct self-update request is also rejected. 3.4. No account or history change is committed. EF-04 (at step 10): Concurrent modification 4.1. The account version no longer matches the loaded version. 4.2. The system rejects the update with Conflict. 4.3. The web client displays “Tài khoản vừa được thay đổi bởi thao tác khác. Vui lòng tải lại trang rồi thử lại.” 4.4. No account or history change is committed. EF-05 (at steps 10–15): Unauthorized requester, expired session, network failure or system error 5.1. The system rejects an unauthorized requester or expired session. 5.2. The web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese error. 5.3. No account or history change is committed. |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Success: all submitted editable personal and contact fields, including “Số giấy phép hành nghề”, contain their new values. Username, role and account status remain unchanged. A separate account change-history entry exists for each stored field whose value actually changed. Cancelled: no update request is sent and no change-history entry is created. Unchanged: the “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled; no update request is sent and no change-history entry is created. Failure: no account or change-history data is partially committed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-04; UC-04 and UC-07 validation/uniqueness rules; UC-06 Change History; no self-update via UC-08; update of Locked accounts without unlocking; Security: Role-based access, Audit trail (IV.2.3); Permission Matrix 4.4 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG48, MSG99 |  |  |

### **2.5 UC-09: Assign Role** {#2.5-uc-09:-assign-role}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----- | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to change a staff account's role among Receptionist, Doctor, Technician and Cashier so that it matches the staff member's work. Each account has exactly one role (BR-02). The sole Admin account is seeded at system initialization; UC-09 cannot assign the Admin role or change the seeded Admin's role. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in and is viewing the target staff account in UC-06. The target account is a non-Admin staff account; the sole seeded Admin account cannot be assigned another role. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Đổi vai trò” on a non-Admin staff account. The system opens “Phân quyền tài khoản”. The system displays the current role and the selectable roles “Lễ tân”, “Bác sĩ”, “Kỹ thuật viên” and “Thu ngân”. ADMIN is not selectable. The system previews the permissions of the selected role. The “Áp dụng vai trò” button remains disabled until the Admin selects a role different from the current role. If the current role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên and the account has a room, the screen warns that the current room assignment will be removed. If the selected role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, the screen reminds the Admin to assign a room after the role change. The Admin clicks “Áp dụng vai trò”. The web client calls the role-change check with newRole and expectedRole. The system verifies that the account and roles are non-Admin, the role has actually changed and the stored role still matches expectedRole. The system counts visits In Examination and paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the account. If there is no work in progress, the system opens “Xác nhận đổi vai trò”. The confirmation shows the username, old role, new role, possible room removal and the warning that all active sessions will be signed out. The Admin clicks “Đổi vai trò”. The system repeats the role and work-in-progress checks. The system changes the role, removes an active room assignment whenever the previous role was Doctor or Technician, preserves Active/Locked status and revokes all account sessions. The system records the role change and security audit. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client displays “Đã đổi vai trò của \[username\] thành \[new role\]” and opens the updated UC-06 account detail. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 8): Cancel the role-selection page 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”. 1.2. The system returns to UC-06. 1.3. The role is unchanged. AF-02 (at step 14): Cancel confirmation 2.1. The Admin closes the “Xác nhận đổi vai trò” dialog. 2.2. The system returns to the role-selection page. 2.3. The role is unchanged. AF-03 (after step 19): The new role requires professional information and a room assignment  3.1. After a successful role change to Doctor or Technician, the system checks whether the account has an academic title and practice-license number. 3.2. If either value is missing, the system asks the Admin to update the account through UC-08. 3.3. The system asks the Admin to assign the account to a room through UC-15. 3.4. Until an active room is assigned, room-dependent waiting lists and work functions are unavailable. 3.5. The use case ends.  AF-04 (at step 16): The account is Locked 4.1. The role change is allowed but the account remains Locked. It cannot sign in until unlocked through UC-10. 4.2. The use case continues at step 17\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The Admin tries to change their own role 1.1. The action is unavailable in the user interface. 1.2. A direct API request is rejected with MSG47. 1.3. The role, room assignment, account status and active sessions remain unchanged. 1.4. The use case ends.  EF-02 (at steps 1 or 3): The Admin role or seeded Admin account is selected  2.1. The system rejects assigning the Admin role to another account. 2.2. The system rejects changing the role of the seeded Admin account. 2.3. The system shows MSG48. 2.4. The role, room assignment, account status and active sessions remain unchanged. 2.5. The use case ends.  EF-03 (at step 5): The selected role is the same as the current role 3.1. The system reports that the role has not changed. Nothing is updated or audited as a role change. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 11): The staff member has work in progress 4.1. The role-change check returns the number of visits In Examination and paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the account. 4.2. If the total number of in-progress items is greater than zero, the web client does not send the change-role command. 4.3. The system displays:    “Không thể đổi vai trò: còn \[visits\] lượt khám và \[orders\] chỉ định đang xử lý.” 4.4. The role, room assignment, account status and active sessions remain unchanged. 4.5. The use case ends. EF-05 (at steps 10 or 15): Concurrent role change 5.1. If another request has changed the target's role since the form was loaded, the system rejects the stale update without changing the role, room assignment or account status, and asks the Admin to reload UC-06 before trying again. 5.2. The use case ends. EF-06 (at steps 9 or 15): Session expired or system error 6.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG99; neither the role nor its room assignment changes. No partial update is committed. 6.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the account has the selected non-Admin role, its status is preserved, any room assignment associated with a previous Doctor/Technician role is removed, all account sessions are revoked, and the change is audited. Failure or cancellation: role, room assignment, status and sessions remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-04, BR-05, BR-19; only Receptionist, Doctor, Technician and Cashier may be assigned; the sole seeded Admin role is immutable. Changing away from Doctor/Technician removes the old room assignment; Locked status remains unchanged; stale concurrent changes are rejected. Security: Role-based access, session revocation and Audit trail (IV.2.3); Permission Matrix 4.4 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG06, MSG12,MSG13, MSG47, MSG48, MSG49, MSG99.  |  |  |

### **2.6 UC-10: Lock/Unlock Account** {#2.6-uc-10:-lock/unlock-account}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to manually Lock or Unlock a non-Admin staff account to control access without deleting its records (BR-01). Manual account status Locked is distinct from the 15-minute temporary password sign-in block in UC-01; UC-10 does not clear that temporary block. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and viewing a non-Admin staff account in UC-06. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Khóa tài khoản” on an Active non-Admin account. Before opening the lock dialog, the web client requests the number of visits In Examination and paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the target account. The system opens “Khóa tài khoản \[username\]”. The dialog displays:    “Vui lòng cung cấp lý do khóa tài khoản này (tối đa 500 ký tự).” The Admin enters the required “Lý do khóa” and clicks “Khóa tài khoản”. The web client trims the reason and sends at most 500 characters together with expectedStatus and expectedVersion. The system verifies Admin authorization, rejects the seeded Admin account and self-administration, and checks the expected account version and status. The system changes the account status from ACTIVE to LOCKED and records the reason, lock time and locking Admin. The system revokes all sessions of the target account. The system records the LOCK account change and ACCOUNT\_LOCKED security audit. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client refreshes the account list and displays “Đã khóa tài khoản \[username\]”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Unlock a Locked account 1.1. The Admin clicks “Mở khóa tài khoản”. 1.2. The system opens “Mở khóa tài khoản” and displays:    “Mở khóa tài khoản \[username\]?” 1.3. The Admin clicks “Mở khóa”. 1.4. The web client sends expectedStatus and expectedVersion. 1.5. The system verifies Admin authorization, protected-account restrictions, version and current LOCKED status. 1.6. The system changes the status to ACTIVE and clears lockReason, lockedAt and lockedByAccountId. 1.7. The system preserves the account’s role, room assignment, must-change-password flag and independent temporary password-login block. 1.8. The system does not create a new login session. 1.9. The system records the UNLOCK account change and ACCOUNT\_UNLOCKED security audit. 1.10. The system returns the updated account detail. 1.11. The web client refreshes the account list and displays “Đã mở khóa tài khoản \[username\]”. AF-02 (at steps 3–5): Cancel Lock or Unlock 2.1. The Admin closes the confirmation dialog. 2.2. The account status remains unchanged. 2.3. No account-change or security-audit success entry is created.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The staff member has work in progress  1.1. The preliminary web-client check finds one or more visits In Examination or paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the account. 1.2. The web client shows MSG49 with the number of visits and orders in progress. 1.3. The “Khóa tài khoản” dialog is not opened. 1.4. No lock command is executed. 1.5. The account status, sessions, role, room assignment and work data remain unchanged. 1.6. The use case ends.  EF-02 (at step 5): Empty lock reason 2.1. The Admin clicks “Khóa tài khoản” without entering a non-blank reason. 2.2. The web client displays “Vui lòng nhập lý do khóa tài khoản”. 2.3. No API request is sent. EF-03 (at steps 1 or 7): Protected account or own account 3.1. The system rejects Lock/Unlock for an account having the ADMIN role. 3.2. The system also rejects self-administration. 3.3. No account status or audit data is changed. EF-04 (at step 7): Stale version, invalid status or concurrent modification 4.1. The target version or status differs from expectedVersion or expectedStatus, or an optimistic-locking conflict occurs while saving. 4.2. The system rejects the request with Conflict. 4.3. The web client displays the corresponding reload message. 4.4. No account-status or audit change is committed. EF-05 (at steps 7–11): Unauthorized requester, expired session, network failure or system error 5.1. The system rejects an unauthorized requester or expired session. 5.2. For a network or system error, the web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese error. 5.3. The account status and audit data remain unchanged. |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Lock success: the account is Locked and all its active sessions are revoked. The lock reason, lock time and locking Admin are recorded. The lock dialog is not opened when the preliminary web-client check reports a visit or paraclinical order in progress. Role, room assignment, work data and historical records remain unchanged. Unlock success: the account is Active and its manual lock information is cleared. Unlocking does not create a login session. The independent temporary password-login block, role, room assignment and password-change requirement remain unchanged. Failure or cancellation: account status, sessions and audit data remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-05; manual Lock/Unlock applies only to non-Admin staff accounts, requires the expected current status, and preserves existing work/history; Data rule: Records are never permanently deleted (I.3.3); Security: Session revocation, Audit trail and separate temporary password-login blocking (IV.2.3; UC-01) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG06, MSG12, MSG32, MSG48, MSG99 |  |  |

### **2.7 UC-11: Reset Password** {#2.7-uc-11:-reset-password}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Admin may reset a non-Admin staff member’s forgotten password using one of two methods. “Hệ thống tự sinh” generates a one-time temporary password that the staff member must change after the next successful sign-in. “Admin nhập thủ công” sets a permanent password agreed with the staff member and does not require another password change. Resetting the seeded Admin account through UC-11 is not allowed. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in and is viewing a non-Admin staff account in UC-06. The staff member has asked for a reset (in person or by phone). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Hệ thống tự sinh” or “Admin nhập thủ công”. For manual mode, the Admin enters “Mật khẩu chính thức” and “Xác nhận mật khẩu”. The Admin submits the form. For manual mode, the web client validates that the password is 8–64 characters, contains no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes and matches its confirmation. If client-side validation succeeds, the system shows a confirmation containing the target’s full name and username. The Admin confirms the reset. The password confirmation is not sent to the backend. For generated mode, the backend generates a 12-character password satisfying the same password policy. The system verifies that the target is not the Admin’s own account or the protected seeded Admin account. The system checks that the account version has not changed. The system replaces the previous password with a protected hash of the new password. For generated mode, the system sets must-change-password to Yes. For manual mode, the system sets must-change-password to No. In both modes, the system clears the failed sign-in count and temporary password-login block. The system revokes all active sessions of the target account. The account’s status, role, room assignment and personal information remain unchanged. The system records the reset without recording the plaintext password or its hash. For generated mode, the generated password is displayed exactly once with “Sao chép”, “In” and “Về chi tiết”. For manual mode, the manually entered permanent password is displayed once with “Sao chép”, “In” and “Về chi tiết”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 3–6): The Admin cancels 1.1. The password is not changed. 1.2. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 14): Password login temporarily blocked after failed attempts 2.1. The system clears the 15-minute temporary password-login block and failure counter (UC-01) without modifying account status. 2.2. The use case continues at step 15\. AF-03 (at step 16): The account status is Locked by Admin 3.1. The password is reset, but the account remains Locked. The user cannot sign in until Admin explicitly Unlocks the account via UC-10. 3.2. The use case continues at step 17\. AF-04 (at steps 18–19): The Admin leaves the password result without copying or printing  4.1. The displayed password cannot be viewed again. 4.2. If the password was not delivered, the Admin must initiate another password reset. 4.3. A new reset replaces the password created by the previous reset. 4.4. This alternative flow applies to both generated and manual modes. 4.5. The use case ends.  |  |  |
|  **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at steps 1, 5 or 9): The target is the Admin’s own account  1.1. The action is unavailable in the user interface. 1.2. A direct self-reset request is rejected with MSG47. 1.3. The Admin changes their own password through UC-03. 1.4. No password, session or account data is changed. 1.5. The use case ends.  EF-02 (at steps 1, 5 or 9): The target is the seeded Admin account  2.1. The system rejects the request and shows MSG48. 2.2. No password, session or account data is changed. 2.3. The use case ends.  EF-03 (at step 4): The manually entered password violates the password policy 3.1. The web client shows MSG43 in the form-level error area. 3.2. No password reset is saved. 3.3. The use case returns to step 2\. EF-04 (at step 4): The password confirmation does not match  4.1. The web client shows MSG44 in the form-level error area. 4.2. No password reset is saved. 4.3. The use case returns to step 2\. EF-05 (at step 10): The account version is stale 5.1. The system detects that the target account has changed since the reset process began. 5.2. The system rejects the reset. 5.3. No new password is issued and no account data is changed. 5.4. The Admin must reload UC-06 before trying again. 5.5. The use case ends.  |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Generated-mode success: the previous password is invalid and all prior sessions are revoked. The generated password is displayed exactly once. The staff member must change the generated password after the next successful sign-in. Manual-mode success: the previous password is invalid and all prior sessions are revoked. The manually entered password becomes the account’s current permanent password and is displayed exactly once on the result screen. Manual mode does not require another password change after sign-in. In both modes, a Locked account remains Locked until explicitly unlocked through UC-10. Role, room assignment and personal information remain unchanged. Failure or cancellation: the password, password-change requirement, sessions and other account data remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-03; only non-Admin staff accounts can be reset; “Admin nhập thủ công” and “Hệ thống tự sinh” must meet IV.2.3 password policy; reset clears temporary password-login blocking but does not Unlock an Admin-locked account; one-time disclosure, concurrent update protection, full session revocation and must-change-password; Security: Password protection, Audit trail (IV.2.3) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG06, MSG12, MSG13, MSG43, MSG44, MSG45, MSG47, MSG48, MSG99.  |  |  |

## **3\. Department Management** {#3.-department-management}

### 

### **3.1 UC-12: View Department List** {#3.1-uc-12:-view-department-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the list of clinical and paraclinical departments, so that I can check their rooms. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects "Khoa / Phòng" in the menu. The system opens "Quản lý khoa/phòng"; the "Phòng chức năng" tab is selected by default, and the Admin selects the "Chuyên khoa" tab for this use case. The system displays the "Chuyên khoa" table with: "Mã khoa", "Tên chuyên khoa", "Loại khoa", "Phòng trực thuộc"(số phòng), "Trạng thái" and "Thao tác". Available actions are "Xem chi tiết", "Chỉnh sửa", "Đang hoạt động/Ngừng hoạt động" . The list is sorted by “Mã khoa” by default and is paginated.  The Admin searches by "Mã khoa" or "Tên chuyên khoa", and/or filters by "Loại khoa" ("Tất cả loại khoa", "Lâm sàng", "Cận lâm sàng") and "Trạng thái" ("Tất cả trạng thái", "Đang hoạt động", "Ngừng hoạt động").  The system updates the list. Search is case- and accent-insensitive. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Clear the search and filters 1.1. The Admin clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”. 1.2. The system removes all search and filter conditions and shows the full list in the default order. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 2 or 4): Change page or page size 2.1. The Admin selects another page, or the number of rows per page (5, 10, 15, 20). 2.2. The system shows the selected page and keeps the current search and filters. 2.3. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2 or 4): No department to show 1.1. There is no department in the system, or no department matches the search and filters. 1.2. If there is no department in the system, the system shows MSG92. If no department matches the search and filters, the system shows MSG01. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The departments are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02; Permission Matrix 4.4 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80, MSG92 |  |  |

### **3.2 UC-13: View Department Detail** {#3.2-uc-13:-view-department-detail}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the details of a department and its rooms, so that I can decide whether to update the department or add rooms. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the department list (UC-12). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks the eye icon (tooltip “Xem chi tiết”) in the “Thao tác” column of a department. The system displays the department information: "Mã khoa", "Tên chuyên khoa", "Loại khoa", "Mô tả" and "Trạng thái". The system displays the rooms belonging to the department, including "Mã phòng", "Tên phòng", "Mô tả", "Vị trí" and "Trạng thái". If the department has no rooms, the system displays MSG92.  The system displays the "Chỉnh sửa" button (UC-14) and the "Đóng" button. The Admin clicks "Đóng" to close the detail popup and return to the department list (UC-12). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | None |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at any step): Session expired or system error 1.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The department details are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | None |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG80  |  |  |

### **3.3 UC-14: Update Department** {#3.3-uc-14:-update-department}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update a department's name, description and status, and update its type when permitted, so that department information remains accurate and up to date throughout the system. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the department list (UC-12) or viewing the department (UC-13). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | Admin clicks the pencil icon (“Chỉnh sửa”) in UC-12 or the “Chỉnh sửa” button in UC-13. The system displays the department update form with the current information: Mã khoa (read-only), Tên chuyên khoa\*, Loại khoa\* (Lâm sàng / Cận lâm sàng), Mô tả, Trạng thái\* (Đang hoạt động / Ngừng hoạt động). The system checks whether the department has ever had a room. If it has never had a room, the “Loại khoa” field is editable. Otherwise, this field is read-only (BR-114). Admin updates one or more editable fields and clicks “Lưu thay đổi”.  The system validates the input according to BR-67, BR-68, BR-69 and BR-70: “Mã khoa” remains unchanged; “Tên khoa” is required, contains 2–100 characters and must be unique; “Loại khoa” must be Lâm sàng or Cận lâm sàng. “Mô tả” is optional and must not exceed 500 characters. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed. If the Admin changes “Trạng thái” from “Đang hoạt động” to “Ngừng hoạt động”, the system checks whether all active rooms can be deactivated according to BR-07 and whether deactivating services exclusively provided by the department violates BR-116. If all conditions are satisfied, the system displays a confirmation dialog listing the affected rooms and services to be deactivated. The Admin confirms the deactivation. The system saves the department changes and deactivates the affected rooms and exclusively provided services.  The system displays MSG03 and opens the department details screen in UC-13.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): The Admin cancels 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”. If there are unsaved changes, the system displays . 1.2. If the Admin selects “Loại bỏ”, the system discards all unsaved changes and returns to the previous screen. If the Admin selects “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa”, the system keeps the update form open at Step 4\. 1.3. The use case ends if the Admin selects “Loại bỏ”. AF-02 (at step 3): Save without changing any value 2.1. The Admin clicks “Lưu thay đổi” without changing any value. 2.2. The system returns to the previous screen without saving. 2.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Required field empty or too long 1.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG08 at the field. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-02 (at step 5): Duplicate name 2.1. The system shows MSG07 at “Tên khoa”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-03 (at step 6): Department deactivation conditions not met 3.1. If any active room cannot be deactivated according to BR-07 or deactivating an affected examination service violates BR-116, the system displays an appropriate warning and keeps all original statuses unchanged. 3.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: The department information is updated. If the department is deactivated, its eligible rooms and exclusively provided services are also deactivated. Failure or cancelled: No changes are saved. The department, room, and service statuses remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-07, BR-67, BR-68, BR-69, BR-70, BR-114, BR-116 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG38, MSG80  |  |  |

## **4\. Room Management** {#4.-room-management}

### **4.1 UC-15: Assign Staff to Room** {#4.1-uc-15:-assign-staff-to-room}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to assign doctors to a clinical room and technicians to a paraclinical room, or remove them, so that staff members are assigned to the appropriate rooms before their shifts are scheduled.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is viewing a room in the room list (UC-16) or an account (UC-06). Active Doctor or Technician accounts exist (UC-07). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Phân công nhân viên” on an active room. The system displays the screen with information about room and two lists: Staff currently assigned to the room.Active staff with the role matching the room type (Doctor for a clinical room, Technician for a paraclinical room), with their current room. Staff with a shift from today onwards or with work in progress are disabled in both lists (BR-55, BR-113). A search box is provided above the second list. If a list has no data, the system shows MSG92 in that list. The Admin selects one or more staff from the second list and clicks “Thêm”.  The system shows MSG06 listing the staff who will be moved from their current room. The Admin confirms. The system saves the assignment: one room per staff member, and the department becomes the room’s department (BR-05). The system displays MSG03 and reloads the room. Moved staff see the new room’s lists after their next screen refresh (BR-19). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Remove a staff member from the room 1.1. The Admin clicks “Gỡ khỏi phòng” on a staff member in the first list. 1.2. The system displays MSG06; the Admin confirms. 1.3. The system removes the staff member from the room. The staff member then has no room and sees MSG48 after the next screen refresh. 1.4. The use case continues at step 7\. AF-02 (at step 5): The change leaves a room without any doctor 2.1. The confirmation dialog also warns that the room cannot receive patients at reception until a doctor is assigned and scheduled again. 2.2. The use case continues at step 5\. AF-03 (at step 1): Started from an account 3.1. In UC-06, for a Doctor or Technician account, the Admin clicks “Phân công phòng”. 3.2. The system shows the active rooms of the matching type, grouped by department; the Admin selects one room. 3.3. The use case continues at step 4 with that account as the selected staff. AF-04 (at step 6): The Admin cancels 4.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” in the confirmation dialog. Nothing is changed. 4.2. The use case returns to step 2\. AF-05 (at step 2): Search 5.1. The Admin types a keyword in the search box (BR-110). 5.2. The system filters the list of available staff by full name or practice licence number as the keyword is entered. 5.3. If nothing matches, the system shows MSG01.  5.4. The use case continues at step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at any step): Session expired or system error 1.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: The staff are assigned to (or removed from) the room and belong to its department. They only see and handle patients and services of their room (BR-19). A clinical room receives patients at reception only when it has a doctor scheduled for that day (BR-96, shifts in UC-86). Failure or cancelled: No assignment is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-05, BR-19, BR-55, BR-96, BR-110, BR-113 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG03, MSG06, MSG12, MSG48, MSG80, MSG92 |  |  |
